render.meaning: envVarKey references an environment variable on the named service; references are copied on Blueprint sync. The documentation does not establish same-array duplicate precedence.

kubernetes.meaning: The kubelet visits container.Env in order and assigns each value by variable name into a map; a later duplicate replaces an earlier entry. The Bex operator preserves the stored App.Env array order.

qualification: This supports inference from actual current persisted App specs. Hosted apply, pod values and deployed Kubernetes/operator/API revisions were not tested. No new Render duplicate-key policy is assumed.
